source: Native AWS CLI; actual CloudWatch Logs and CloudWatch responses, no mocks
substitutions: Owned resource suffix normalized to owned; caller account normalized to 000000000000. Deliberately wrong account 999999999999 remains distinct; native timestamps, metric values and field presence are retained.

limitations: Bounded absent data is unresolved, never evidence of permanent loss.
One owned group, fixed streams, one region/account; no transformer or centralized source is installed.
Cross-subscription/metric regex quota is unmeasured: no owned subscription destination is provisioned.
Metric publication is at least once per AWS documentation; observed values do not establish exactly-once guarantees.
Partial ingestion admission/rejection is not metric publication evidence; only returned metric points prove production.
No DeleteMetric API exists. Published custom metrics age out under CloudWatch retention after publishers are removed.

cleanup.publisher_state: No continuing publisher: owned metric filters and group removed when checks pass; no external publisher or worker was created. Previously accepted asynchronous data may still arrive.
cleanup.residual: Custom metric data has no DeleteMetric API and expires according to CloudWatch retention; no ongoing publication or deletable resources remain when verified.

scope: One fresh group/stream; wildcard metric value/dimensions, undefined space selector and @source.log.

wildcard_metric_value.matcher: Both single and multiple candidate JSON events match the wildcard filter pattern; transformation admission is independently rejected.

wildcard_dimension.message: Invalid metric transformation: dimension value must be valid selector
wildcard_dimension.matcher: Both single and multiple candidate JSON events match the wildcard filter pattern; wildcard dimension extractor is rejected.

undefined_space_selector.native_matching: SPACE 17 and SPACE 31 match, extracting $kind and $value, not $missing. Both events positively readable in owned stream.
undefined_space_selector.metric_query: Five complete GetMetricData polls and final GetMetricStatistics return no SpaceMissing point; bounded non-observation only.

source_log_dimension.interpretation: Direct owned-group ingestion emits the exact log group name, not ARN or stream name. Positive ListMetrics identity, GetMetricData Sum29, and GetMetricStatistics SampleCount1 corroborate.

baseline.interpretation: Both baseline values positively published at their respective event timestamp minutes, confirming ingested single/multiple candidate corpus reached publication.

unresolved: Undefined $missing space extraction was admitted but no metric point was returned during this338.96-second run. This is bounded non-observation, not evidence of permanent delivery loss.
Wildcard metricValue and dimension transformations were rejected before publication; no runtime candidate-selection or fan-out behavior is inferred from matcher success.
@source.log behavior is observed for direct ingestion into one owned group only, not centralized or transformed logs.
